item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
# Recall 0.2.0
## Features
- feat(release): notes draft, Sparkle sign, appcast push, tag, gh release - feat(release): --publish flag with preflight + version bump - feat(settings): Check for Updates… button in About section - feat(updater): wire UpdaterService into ServiceContainer + AppDelegate - feat(updater): UpdaterService wraps Sparkle with MAS-receipt gate - feat(launch-at-login): register Recall as a login item - feat(behavior-mode): make LiveMode the canonical driver, drop the toggle - feat(helper): instrument RecallHelper with Sentry - feat(distribution): non-sandbox DMG ship + onboarding polish
## Fixes
- fix(popover): wrap re-entry title/question and put `?` at the end - fix(downloader): heal existing tokenizer_config.json on every launch - fix(downloader): patch tokenizer_class on download to keep swift-transformers happy
## Performance
- perf(screen-analysis): slow cadence to 30s on base-tier Apple GPUs
## Other
- release: v0.2.0 - chore(plist): wire Sparkle feed URL + EdDSA public key - chore(deps): add Sparkle 2.x for auto-updates - chore(build): silence build warnings - tune(qwen): per-prompt sampling profiles + raise vision input to 2558px
